facts.business: Vaibhav Global Limited is an omnichannel, fully integrated retailer specializing in fashion jewellery and lifestyle products, operating home shopping television networks (Shop LC in the US, Shop TJC and Ideal World in the UK, Shop LC in Germany) and digital platforms reaching over 127 million households.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Germany business expected to contribute positively to group profitability from FY27 onwards

key_risks: Cyber security and data privacy risks
facts.related_party_note: Vaibhav Global Employee Stock Option Welfare Trust (ESOP Trust) included in standalone financial statements
